focus: 今天的重點：看日曆分清 Tuesday 和 Thursday、看天氣、Where…?、How old…?、讀公告找時間和地點、is not 否定句、用 or 連接問句。
notes: 聽力第 1 題：Tuesday 和 Thursday 聽起來很像。Thursday 開頭要輕咬舌頭（th），可以請 Kyro 唸給您聽，再互相考一考。
閱讀段落填空第 2 格：主詞是 she（一隻貓），動詞要加 s：drinks。可以和昨天的 Kane and I play 對照，看 Kyro 分不分得清楚。
寫作第 1 題：not 放在 is 後面（is not / isn't）；第 2 題兩個問句只有地點不同，用 or 連起來，句尾要問號。

listen.q: What day is on the calendar?
listen.why: 日曆上寫 THURSDAY，是星期四。Tuesday 是星期二，兩個字聽起來很像，Thursday 開頭要咬舌頭。
圖上是大太陽，天氣晴朗：sunny。rainy 是下雨，snowy 是下雪。

talk: Where do you read books, Kyro?
listen.why: Where 問「在哪裡」，要回答地點：In my room（在我的房間）。At night 是回答時間。

talk: How old is your grandma, Kyro?
listen.why: How old 問「幾歲」，要回答年紀：She is seventy（她七十歲）。

talk: Kyro, what time is your art class?
OK. I can take you there.
listen.q: What time is Kyro's art class?
listen.why: Kyro 說 It's at two o'clock：美術課在兩點。

talk: Kyro, do you want some noodles?
No, thanks. I want rice and soup.
listen.q: What does Kyro want to eat?
listen.why: Kyro 說 No, thanks，不要麵；他要的是 rice and soup（飯和湯）。

talk: Hi, I'm Lily. I am in second grade. I love fruit. My favorite fruit is yellow and long. I eat one after lunch every day.
listen.q: Which fruit does Lily like best?
listen.why: Lily 說她最喜歡的水果 yellow and long（黃色、長長的），是香蕉。

talk: Hello, class. We will go to the park after lunch. It is hot today. Please take your water bottle. You do not need your bag or your book.
listen.q: What does the teacher want the class to take?
listen.why: 老師說 Please take your water bottle：要帶水壺；書包和書都不用帶（do not need）。

vocab.stem: It is raining. My shoes are ____.

vocab.why: 圓形是一種形狀：shape，是學校 LA 的單字。

vocab.stem: We do not go to school ____ Sunday.
vocab.why: 星期幾前面用 on：on Sunday。at 用在幾點，例如 at nine。

cloze.passage: Mimi is a small gray cat. She lives in a house {1} a big tree. Every morning, she {2} milk from a blue cup. Then she sits by the window and looks at the birds. She is a happy cat.

items.why: 房子在大樹的附近：near a big tree。
主詞是 she，每天做的事，動詞要加 s：drinks。

text.intro: 讀下面學校的公告，回答三個問題。
text.title: School Book Sale
lines: Our book sale is on Friday.
It is in the school gym.
It starts at nine in the morning.
Please bring a bag for your books.

items.stem: What day is the book sale?
items.why: 公告第一句：on Friday，在星期五。
公告說 It is in the school gym：在學校的體育館。

items.stem: What should you bring to the sale?
items.why: 公告最後說 Please bring a bag：請帶一個袋子裝書。

near: not 前面要有 is：The soup is not hot.
not 要放在 is 的後面。
有 is 的句子，直接在 is 後面加 not，不用 do。
hints: 在 is 的後面加上 not。

write.instr: 用 or 把兩個問句合成一句。
accept: is tom at home or at school
is tom at home or school
is tom at home or is he at school
is tom at home or is tom at school
write.model: Is Tom at home or at school?
near: 要問「哪一個」，用 or，不是 and。
兩個地點中間要加 or。
這是問句，Is 要放在最前面。
hints: 兩個問句只有地點不一樣，用 or 把地點連起來。
Is Tom at home ___ at school?

write.instr: 依照順序點字卡，排成一句話。
hints: 大寫字母開頭的字放第一個，有句點的字放最後。
球的標價是 60 元：sixty；數一數有 5 顆星星：five。
書在椅子的上面：on the chair。
